name: repo-agent-guide
body: The apg repository's own agent guide `AGENTS.md` (present in the graph as a scanned File): the repo-level guidance agents read when working in this checkout. It is not part of the `opencode-suite/` distribution (not embedded via `include_str!`, not installed by `apg init`), so it is modelled separately from `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`. It carries the file-tool guidance ("Other tools"; the "Read those files with read, grep, or bash" line) that must state the same graph-first qualifier as the installed navigator prompt.
